title: Bruce Springsteen's $50 million New Jersey archive opens, housing 48,000-plus items
summary_full: Monmouth University in New Jersey has proudly unveiled the Bruce Springsteen Center for American Music, featuring over 48,000 artifacts that delve into the rich heritage of American music and celebrate the impact of Bruce Springsteen. Its inaugural exhibit highlights the evolution of protest music across history, and interactive setups invite attendees to immerse themselves in the experience.
